caption_L1: This line diagram is titled Distribution of U.S. biotech and non-biotech corn acreage from 2006 to 2019 , by type. The x-axis plots Year while the y-axis plots Non-biotech.
caption_L2L3: Non biotech acreage fell rapidly from 2006 to 2008. In 2008 it was 0.4, though I’m unsure if this means 0.4% of the total acreage. It reached its lowest point in 2014 and soon after stabilised at about 0.8.
